b'# tinydl

A small command-line downloader.

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [-o OUTPUT] [-q]
```

## Options

| Option | Help text |
|--------|-----------|
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

Download to stdout:

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip
```

Download to a file:

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip -o file.zip
```

Download quietly (no progress output):

```
tinydl https://example.com/file.zip -q
```'
